title: feat: add JPEG2000 and WebP image format support
head: eddyflores100-lang:feat/jpeg2000-webp-support
body:
## Summary

Closes #2.

Added support for JPEG2000 (.jp2, .j2k) and WebP (.webp) image formats.

## Changes

- **mia/core/preprocessing.py**: Added `SUPPORTED_FORMATS` constant and `is_format_supported()` classmethod. PIL/Pillow natively supports both JPEG2000 (via OpenJPEG plugin) and WebP, so no additional libraries are needed.
- **mia/core/analyzer.py**: Updated `image_extensions` in `batch_analyze()` to include `.jp2`, `.j2k`, `.webp`.
- **mia/core/model_loader.py**: Updated `supported_formats` for all 4 model configurations.
- **tests/unit/test_preprocessing.py**: 10 new tests covering format detection, validation, and end-to-end processing.
- **README.md**: Documented new formats.

## Test Results

```
15 passed (5 original + 10 new), 0 failed
```

No regressions — all existing tests still pass.

## Why JPEG2000 matters for medical imaging

JPEG2000 is particularly important because:
- DICOM often uses JPEG2000 compression for storage
- Lossless JPEG2000 preserves diagnostic quality
- Many PACS systems export .jp2 natively

## Checklist

- [x] Update ImagePreprocessor to handle new formats
- [x] Add validation tests
- [x] Update documentation with supported formats list
